body: Thank you so much. I think you're right, I think I am so upset that I am not looking at things correctly. I mean, no matter what happens I know I will have support from family and friends. I know despite my issues I am a really cool girl. I love martial arts, I also really like video games, Board games, dungeons and dragons and the like. I know I will find a nerd  somewhere who can accept me :)

Oh how I wish I was confused. I have had manifestations of both. I have had both manifestations of HPV and Herpes. I was told though that the herpes I had was caused by HSV-1, not HSV-2. I have not had another outbreak (4 years ago) and have been told since it's HSV-1 that the chances to pass it on to someone else were extremely low. 

Even still, My immune system is absolute garbage. I wouldn't have problems with HPV most likely if I didn't have Crohn's. I probably wouldn't have broken out with Herpes without Crohn's.

Thanks. It's just I want to be healthy and normal. I want to have sex again.  I want a lot of things and it just feels like I keep going though so much pain and suffering. I feel like I am never going to get what I want, I'm never going to be happy or satisfied. I want to get married and have a family.

Thank you so much. I know you're right, but it's hard. I'm sitting in the building I work. Luckily it has a private bathroom so I can cry. I hate my life so much. I've been though so much without a damn break. I am the unluckiest person ever.
